name: Letter from Lor'themar Theron
summary: This diplomatic dispatch, penned by Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron of Silvermoon, confirms the execution of the Scourge-aligned traitor Dar'Khan Drathir. Entrusted to an envoy traveling south to the Undercity, the missive serves as vital proof that Quel'Thalas possesses the strength to handle its internal threats and join the Horde as an equal power.

sections.title: A Plea Turned Bargaining Chip
sections.body: Following the devastation of Quel'Thalas, Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron sought allies to safeguard his recovering kingdom against the lingering Scourge. Whispers among the Horde questioned whether the blood elves had the grit to reclaim their lands or if they would become a liability. The death of the traitor Dar'Khan Drathir at the hands of elven champions changed that calculus entirely. By committing news of this victory to parchment, Lor'themar crafted an opening for formal entry into Thrall's Horde, relying on his envoy to prove that the Sin'dorei could pull their own weight.

sections.title: To the Banshee Queen
sections.body: Addressed specifically to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the letter is more than an ordinary diplomatic courtesy. As the former Ranger-General of Silvermoon, Sylvanas retains a profound interest in the fate of Quel'Thalas and has championed the Sin'dorei cause within the Horde's high councils. Hearing of Dar'Khan's demise brings personal vindication to the Banshee Queen, who utilizes Lor'themar's missive to arrange further diplomatic introductions in Orgrimmar, smoothing over friction with the Darkspear trolls and Warchief Thrall.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this letter?
faq.answer: The letter reports the death of the traitor Dar'Khan Drathir and affirms that Quel'Thalas is securing its borders. Regent Lord Lor'themar Theron sends it as tangible proof of elven capability to petition for entry into the Horde on equal terms.

faq.q: Why is the letter brought to Sylvanas first instead of Thrall?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner is the former Ranger-General of Silvermoon and the blood elves' strongest advocate among the Horde's leaders. Undercity serves as the natural staging ground before the elven envoy travels onward to Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Who was Dar'Khan Drathir and why is his death important?
faq.answer: Dar'Khan was the high elf magistrate who betrayed Quel'Thalas to Arthas and the Scourge during the Third War. Eliminating him removes the foremost threat to the Ghostlands and demonstrates to potential allies that the Sin'dorei are resilient enough to handle their own crises.

faq.q: How does the letter help relations with the Darkspear trolls?
faq.answer: Centuries of bitter war in the northern forests left immense distrust between elves and trolls. Demonstrating martial strength and eliminating a major Scourge commander reassures the Darkspear and Warchief Thrall that accepting Quel'Thalas will strengthen the Horde rather than burden it.

angles.text: The missive marks a pivotal turning point for the Horde, providing proof that the blood elves are formidable enough to defend the northern front of the Eastern Kingdoms alongside the Forsaken.
For the Forsaken, Lor'themar's correspondence validates Sylvanas Windrunner's sponsorship of her former kin and secures an enduring northern alliance for the Undercity.
